instruction: Use command-line automation for the installed SolidCAM/SOLIDWORKS CAM environment; do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_template.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\variants.json. Generate one independent posted program per variant, using each variant's pocket size, bottom Z, tool diameter, and program number from the JSON file. Save the posted NC outputs exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_01.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_02.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_03.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_04.nc, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\variant_05.nc.
